## About
Integrity Customs is a family owned auto body and paint repair shop. You'll find us on Elliott Rd in Henderson and on Speedway Blvd in Las Vegas.
We repair damaged bodies, refinish damaged paint and fix collision damage. Our work is guaranteed, and quotes are free and fast.
Customers write about Joey, Mandy and Gabriel Jr. by name, and about being kept informed the whole way through. We're rated 4.9 on Google from 137 reviews.

## Services
- Refinish Damaged paint: Scratches, scuffs and damaged paint refinished to match.
- Repair Damaged Body: Bodywork to bring your car back to factory shape.
- Auto collisions: Collision repair, from a fender bender to bigger damage.
- Complete used car reconditioning: Full reconditioning for used cars, for dealers and personal customers.
- Insurance Deductible Assistance: Ask us about help with your deductible.
- Paintless dent repair (PDR): Done with HOT SHOTS, Keith.
- Shuttles cars to and from locations: We can move your car to and from locations for your convenience.
- Aftermarket paint modification (appointment only): Custom paint work, by appointment only.

## FAQ
Q: Are quotes free?
A: Yes. Quotes are free and fast. Reach out with your vehicle info and we'll get back to you.

Q: Do you work with dealerships?
A: Yes. We service used car lots, service drive cars and any dealership auto body needs.

Q: Where is the Henderson shop?
A: Our Henderson shop is at 253 Elliott Rd, Suite 9, Henderson NV 89011. We also have a Speedway location in Las Vegas.
